description: Land Title Settlement Department - Divulankadawalwa, Kasumpokuna Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120040 (24/0093)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land administration, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
